title: AO-MA Run Budget (autonomous run governor config)
description: Hard caps for an autonomous AO-MA run, consumed by the AO-MA-11I run governor. Every limit is REQUIRED with an explicit value: there is no 'null = unlimited' (that would be fail-open). To run without a meaningful cap you must set a deliberately high explicit value, which stays auditable. Each configured budget axis has a matching REQUIRED state counter (see the governor): a configured cap whose usage axis is absent from run state is a fail-closed halt, never a silent continue. Cost capping is dormant under the CLI-subscription model (RI-7.8c: no cost API), so cost_tracking.available is const false and token count is the primary runaway guard. This config is governor input only; it is NOT a governance authority and cannot widen support, claim production, enable live adapters, authorize GitHub writes, or perform side effects.

max_slices.description: Maximum slices an autonomous run may start. Governor halts before starting one once slices_started >= this.

max_consensus_rounds.description: Maximum 3-AI consensus rounds before escalation (matches the merge-lane max of 3).

max_retries_per_slice.description: Maximum retries for the CURRENT slice. 0 means no retry is permitted (retries_used >= this halts).

max_total_retries.description: Global retry cap across all slices (a deterministic backstop independent of per-slice retries; guards state drift / slice renaming).

max_governor_steps.description: Maximum governor evaluations (the master plan's 'iteration cap'); a hard ceiling on autonomous-loop length.

max_wall_clock_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock seconds; elapsed is computed from an injected 'now' (deterministic). Halts when elapsed >= this.

max_total_output_tokens.description: Maximum cumulative output tokens; the primary runaway guard. Deterministic schema-backed counter only (no provider API read).

cost_tracking.description: Cost capping is dormant (RI-7.8c CLI-subscription model: no cost API). available is const false; max_cost_usd must be null while dormant.

github_write_authorized.description: The governor never authorizes GitHub writes (issues/PRs/merges). Pinned false.

side_effect_authority.description: The governor is a pure-decision policy with no side-effect authority; the executor (not the governor) writes checkpoints.

governor_authority.description: Pins that the governor only decides whether an autonomous run may continue; it is NOT release authority.
